saying: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open
source: Drawn from the BSB, STEPBible TAHOT and TAGNT, and the commentaries named under each note.

layers.evidence: Rests on the verse's two pictures of water from below and from above.
layers.text: God's knowledge is seen in the waters of the earth. By it the deep waters below burst out as springs and rivers, and the skies above drip with dew.

layers.evidence: Clarke reads the line of God breaking up the fountains of the great deep to bring the Flood, as well as of the springs He opens; Gill notes that some refer it to Genesis 7:11. Both verses pair tehom (the deep) with baqa (to break open).
layers.text: The Hebrew words for the depths being broken open are the same ones used at the Flood, when "all the fountains of the great deep burst forth" (Genesis 7:11). The wisdom that broke open the deep in Noah's day also opens the springs that water the earth.
